resources.string: Draw a circle on anything to read it
Select any area of your screen with a circle or a rectangle. The selected region is processed completely offline by on-device OCR (Tesseract) and you can then search or copy the text.
Needed so the floating button and the selection overlay can be drawn on top of the app you are using.

Android 11 only allows screen capture through an Accessibility service. This service is used exclusively to take the screenshot of the area you select - it does not read, log or upload any other content.
The draggable button that starts a selection from inside any app.
Circle search button. Drag to move it, tap to select a region of the screen.
Ready. Tap the blue button anywhere to select text.
Grant the \"Display over other apps\" permission to use the floating button.
Enable the accessibility service to enable screen capture.

Screenshots are kept in memory only and the temporary crop is deleted as soon as OCR finishes. Text recognition runs offline; nothing is uploaded. The INTERNET permission is only used when you explicitly tap \"Search\".
Drag a circle (or rectangle) around what you want to read, then tap Extract
Drag further to select a bigger area
No text was found in the selected area. Try selecting a slightly bigger region, or make sure the text is not too small.
The OCR engine could not be started. Check that assets/tessdata/eng.traineddata is present in the APK.
There is no text to copy
There is no text to search for
Screen capture is not available. Make sure the accessibility service is enabled.
Please wait a moment before taking another screenshot.
This screen is protected (it contains sensitive content such as a password field) and cannot be captured.
This device does not support screenshot capture through the accessibility service.
The screenshot could not be taken.
The screen looks empty or fully hidden - nothing to read.
No browser is available to perform the search.
Take a screenshot of the region you select so text can be read offline.

Allows ScreenCircleSearch to take a screenshot of the current screen when you tap the floating button, so that the selected area can be processed by on-device text recognition. The app does not inspect, store or transmit any other screen content.
